meta.profile_notes: No AMS needed! Parts need to be glued in.

meta.profile_title: All Parts on One Plate (Print by Object — X/P series only)
meta.profile_notes: Identical to the original with split parts, but everything is on a single plate for both speed and convenience . This layout is optimized for the X/P Series. There are separate profiles for the A and H series. NOTE: Unfortunately, MakerWorld handles “print by object” profiles exceptionally poorly and only shows compatibility for the printer from which a profile is saved. If the Handy app doesn’t show it as compatible for yours due to this, open the 3MF in Bambu Studio instead and it should be ready to go, or use Auto Arrange to further optimize for your exact setup. Should go without saying, but an AMS is required — unless you add pauses and manually swap filament between objects. Be sure the print sequence remains “Print by Object” or you'll unnecessarily go through a lot of filament and waste a lot of time, completely defeating the purpose of this profile. If you like this profile, please remember to rate it , boost the designer and explore their other models. If you really like this profile, feel free to check out my models as well and boost one (or more) of them if you have boosts to spare. 😊
